title: Assess repairability (agentic)
description: Read-only investigation via a bounded Deep Agents loop: name-match, payment-history search, and sanctions pre-check, emitting a repair_verdict with evidence[]. deep_agent kind — nemoclaw-only, HITL-gated, memoized (ADR-021). RULE (top-precedence): if the info_resolution input is present, its outcome is AUTHORITATIVE — set repair_verdict to 'repairable' when outcome is 'resolved', and to 'unrepairable' when outcome is 'cannot_obtain'. ONLY when info_resolution is absent or null, assess repairability from the dossier as normal (repairable / unrepairable / needs_info).
